TP1.placementNote: Pad and number together. The pad is the dash about 75 px left of the label, at the top left corner of the board above C108.

TP3.placementNote: Pad and number together; the pad is the vertical tick about 75 px above the label. TP3 and TP8 are a pair, left of U15.

TP4.placementNote: Pad and number together. Placed outright: the reader's only TP4 read was on TP1's label at the far left of the board.

TP5.placementNote: Pad and number together, in the top-right row between TP4 and TP10.

TP6.placementNote: The reader's verified label box, widened. TP6's pad could not be separated from SW1's switch outline at the grid resolution used, so this covers the label and the artwork immediately around it rather than a measured pad.

TP7.placementNote: Pad and number together; leftmost of the TP7/TP4/TP5 group, above R3.

TP8.placementNote: Pad and number together; the pad is the vertical tick above the label. Second digital common, on the same net as TP4.

TP9.placementNote: Pad and number together. The reader never found TP9 at all -- the same blind spot A18 hit, where the 9 reads as an S and the marker is attributed to TP5. Placed outright, at the right-hand end of the top row beside CR1.

TP10.placementNote: Pad and number together; TP10's label sits one line above the rest of the row, with its pad below it.

TP11.placementNote: Pad and number together; the pad is below the label here rather than above.

TP12.placementNote: The reader's verified label box, widened. TP12 stands alone above U23; its pad was not separately measured.

TP13.placementNote: The reader's verified label box, widened. TP13 and TP14 sit either side of the polarity marking under BT1, which could not be told from a pad at the grid resolution used. On the photographed board TP13 is the square pad and TP14 the round one, both directly across the soldered cell.

TP14.placementNote: The reader's verified label box, widened; see TP13.

C1.placementNote: Can outline measured from the drawing's ink extent, checked by eye. The reader had put C1 on C126's label; the part itself is the lone can above P62, right of C3.

C4.placementNote: Label box measured off the glyph run, checked by eye. The reader had put C4 on C9's label at the far left of the board; C4 is in fact between C12 and U52.

C9.placementNote: Label box measured off the glyph run, checked by eye. The reader had put C9 on C2's label; C9 is one of the two crystal load capacitors beside Y1, next to R4.

C17.placementNote: Can outline measured from the drawing's ink extent, checked by eye. The 47uF aluminium can between R51 and C13; the reader never found it.

C104.placementNote: Label box measured off the glyph run, checked by eye. The reader had put C104 on C109's label; C104 is the bypass capacitor left of T51.

C122.placementNote: Label box measured off the glyph run, checked by eye. Between U21 and U22 in the bypass row; the reader never found it.

C124.placementNote: Label box measured off the glyph run, checked by eye. The reader had put C124 on C129's label; C124 sits left of U24 at the top of the board.

C133.placementNote: Label box measured off the glyph run, checked by eye. Between U22 and U33; the reader never found it. The 'C' of the label touches the capacitor outline, which is why the glyph run had to be extended left by hand.

CR4.placementNote: Label box measured off the glyph run, checked by eye. Top of the right-hand diode column, above CR3; the reader never found it.

CR7.placementNote: Label box measured off the glyph run, checked by eye. Top of the left-hand diode column, above CR6; the reader never found it.

T51.placementNote: Body outline traced by flood-filling the drawing from the designator, checked by eye. The 8 MHz transformer can, between C104 and C111.

U1.placementNote: Body outline traced by flood-filling the drawing from the designator, checked by eye. The reader had put U1 on TP5's label.

U2.placementNote: Body outline traced by flood-filling the drawing from the designator, checked by eye. The reader had put U2 on U20's label, half the board away.

U4.placementNote: Body outline traced by flood-filling the drawing from the designator, checked by eye. The reader had put U4 on U41's label.

U5.placementNote: Body outline traced by flood-filling the drawing from the designator, checked by eye. The reader had put U5 on U8's label; U5 is the PLD in the row with U3 and Z1.

U9.placementNote: Body outline traced by flood-filling the drawing from the designator, checked by eye. Between Y1 and C106; the reader never found it.

U27.placementNote: Body outline traced by flood-filling the drawing from the designator, checked by eye. In the bottom row between C127 and C126; the reader never found it.

U32.placementNote: Body outline traced by flood-filling the drawing from the designator, checked by eye. Left of C132 near the battery; the reader never found it.

Z2.placementNote: Body outline traced by flood-filling the drawing from the designator, checked by eye. Below R54 and above BT1; the reader never found it.
